title: Juniper and the Safehouse
author: Theo Marchetti
blurb: Xanthe Okafor, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
